dataset.title: UAV Laser Scanning and Photogrammetry of TUM Downtown Campus
dataset.datasetRole: candidate source-discovery only; no building selected or evidence accepted
metadataLimitations: The metadata PDF was downloaded in CI and its publisher MD5 was verified; an actual SHA-256 was computed and pinned in verifiedMetadata.document.

The PDF declares WGS 84 / UTM 32N (EPSG:32632) for point clouds and meters/degrees, but its text also describes XYZ coordinates as local. The exact selected LAS/LAZ header/VLR and any local-to-georeferenced transform must be checked before using coordinates.
Elevation is described as above mean sea level, but no named vertical datum or geoid model was found in the extracted text. Vertical registration remains blocked.
The reported ICP transform is only for aligning ULS point-cloud part 3 to part 1; it must not be assumed to transform a candidate GLB or an arbitrary source frame.
The photogrammetry-vs-ULS M3C2 mean (1.7 cm) and standard deviation (22.8 cm) compare related source products from the same campaign, not a platform candidate against independent held-out truth.
The exact asset/version licence and use-specific rights still need a human review; the metadata PDF does not by itself approve licence terms.
The campus dataset does not yet map a selected image subset, ULS crop and individual LOD3 model to one identified building.
No selected source images/point-cloud crops have been downloaded and SHA-256 verified locally for the intended building, and no platform-generated candidate GLB or held-out controls exist.
BRF-28 inspects only a bounded LAZ prefix; it deliberately refuses to consume a full HTTP 200 response and does not produce a whole-file hash.

BRF-28 read the first 8 MiB of the ULS LAZ via HTTP 206; header VLRs declare WGS 84 / UTM zone 32N (GeoKey projected-code candidate 32632) and metre units, but no named vertical CRS key was present. Source frame interpretation still needs review.
